applicability: Dashboard reads made when a leaf task is selected and when its reviewer is opened from the task entry.
conditions: The reviewer is opened with no subject from the task entry.
The subject catalogue answers within SUBJECT_HOLD_MS (750 ms); a slower or stalled catalogue releases into one task-context review read at the bound (ruling on L47-R1-F1).
exclusions: Reads made by the reviewer's own refresh or by the developer choosing another subject.
A catalogue answering after the bound, whose late subject jump belongs to L48.
statement: Selecting a leaf makes one summary read, no catalogue read and one committed change-set read; opening the reviewer reads the catalogue once, keyed on the comparison rather than the global analytics document, and asks the review only for the subject the catalogue chose.
